title: Hangar Zero
subtitle: Build · Test · Rebuild
intro.heading: Three missions. One equipment bay.
intro.body: Match the platform and sensor to each construction task. Inspect all readiness indicators, address any blocker, then decide whether the loadout can be cleared.
intro.goal: Goal: clear all three missions and score at least 80%.
bay.title: Equipment bay
bay.pickOne: Select one item in each equipment rack.
bay.selectHint: Click or use Tab and Enter to select equipment.
bay.inspectHint: Inspect each indicator. Address any blocker before clearance.
bay.positioning: Positioning awareness: confirm the setup supports the mission's location requirements.
mission.facade.label: Mission A · Façade
mission.facade.title: Close visual inspection
mission.facade.brief: Inspect a building façade visually. Controlled positioning close to the building matters; collect clear visual information.
mission.mapping.label: Mission B · Open area
mission.mapping.title: Visual site mapping
mission.mapping.brief: Map a large open construction area visually. Efficient area coverage matters; sustained hover is not the defining requirement.
mission.geometry.label: Mission C · 3D survey
mission.geometry.title: Building geometry survey
mission.geometry.brief: Survey a building and its immediate site. Controlled positioning around the building and 3D geometric information are required.
decision.help: Hold if any part is unsuitable or a readiness issue remains. Clear only when the complete setup is suitable.
feedback.incomplete: Select a platform and sensor, then inspect every readiness indicator before deciding.
feedback.held: Good hold. Review the flagged part of the loadout, correct it, then clear the mission.
feedback.unnecessaryHold: This loadout is ready to clear. Recheck your clearance judgement.
feedback.blocked: Clearance blocked. Revise the flagged part of the loadout before trying again.
feedback.ignored: This issue still needs attention. An unresolved readiness issue cannot be accepted as ready.
feedback.cleared: Mission cleared. The platform, information type and readiness now match the task.
feedback.issue.platform: Platform suitability: consider the mission's positioning and area-coverage needs.
feedback.issue.sensor: Sensor suitability: match the information requested by the mission.
feedback.issue.readiness: Readiness: inspect and address the issue before clearance.
results.heading: Loadout complete
results.explanation: Each mission awards points for platform, sensor, readiness and clearance judgement. Corrected decisions remain eligible for credit.
results.saved: Result saved. You may close this activity or replay.
mission.title: Build for the façade
mission.brief: Prepare the workshop aircraft for a close visual inspection of a damaged façade. It must hold position beside the wall, capture readable surface detail, and sustain the complete automated run.
rack.platformHint: Choose how the aircraft will fly
bench.label: Assembly bench
bench.title: Your aircraft
bench.help: Drag a part onto its socket, or select it then select the socket.
bench.defaultHint: The starting build is unsuitable. Inspect and rebuild it for the façade.
bench.mounted: Part mounted. Check the whole build before testing.
bench.unmounted: Sensor removed. Mount a suitable replacement.
bench.returned: Use what you observed to rebuild and retest.
bench.pickHint: Select the matching socket on the aircraft.
bench.platformHint: Select an airframe in the rack first.
bench.sensorHint: Select a sensor in the rack first.
battery.low.title: Battery warning.
battery.low.inspect: The current pack cannot sustain the full capture run. Replace it in the battery bay.
battery.charged.title: Battery ready.
battery.charged.inspect: This pack can sustain the full test flight.
schematic.title: Mission drawing
schematic.body: Stay beside the wall long enough to image the marked crack.
test.label: Flight test
test.title: Watch the test run
test.subtitle: Observe the aircraft path, sensor captures, and endurance. Return to the bench to change anything that fails.
test.firstHint: A test reveals how this build behaves.
test.lastSuccess: The last build completed the inspection.
test.lastFailure: The last build needs another change.
test.platformGood: The aircraft held beside the façade.
test.platformBad: The airframe swept past without a stable hover.
test.sensorGood: The sensor captured visible façade details.
test.sensorBad: Thermal data did not show the visual crack.
test.batteryBad: Power ended the capture run early.
test.sceneFailure: Return to the bench and revise the build.
mission.label: Construction mission
scene.label: Workshop bay 04
scene.title: Aircraft preparation stand
scene.default: Orbit around the aircraft. Inspect its mounted components, then physically rebuild anything that does not suit the work order.
scene.pickup: Component released. Move it across the bench; its compatible mount will brighten as it approaches.
scene.detached: {mount} released. The component now moves freely on the bench.
scene.rejected: That mounting location is incompatible. The component returned to a safe tray position.
scene.incomplete: The aircraft needs both a payload and battery before the test can begin.
scene.reset: The original workshop configuration has been restored.
scene.failureReturn: Use the physical evidence from the test. Inspect, remove, and replace the component that limited the run.
scene.successReturn: The proved configuration remains assembled on the stand. You can inspect it or reset the workshop.
controls.primary: Drag empty space to orbit · scroll to zoom
controls.secondary: Drag a 3D component to move it · click a component to inspect it
console.label: Aircraft state
console.title: Workshop console
inspect.low: One of four battery indicators is lit. This pack may start the aircraft but cannot sustain the full inspection.
inspect.charged: All four battery indicators are lit. This pack is ready for the complete automated run.
inspect.rgb: The RGB camera records visible surface imagery and the façade details requested in the work order.
inspect.thermal: The thermal payload records qualitative heat patterns; it will not provide the visible crack imagery requested here.
test.watch: Watch the aircraft, scan beam, capture board, and power behavior before diagnosing the configuration.
test.successBody: The aircraft held its position, recorded six visible façade images, and retained power through the full run.
